# Rule B's baseline (ADR-0065, "Rule B: no ecosystem pattern in the
# engine"): today's Go files of internal/ whose string literals hold a
# language pack's marker, extension or path pattern, read by
# TestRuleBNoEcosystemPatternInTheEngine in ../ruleb_test.go.
#
# One line a file and a token: `<file> <token> <literals holding it>`.
# It only shrinks: a literal more fails the test, as does a line counting
# more than the code holds. Move the pattern to a pack, then lower or
# remove its line; never add one: put a new pattern in a pack, or a
# `// converges: <reason>` comment on its line.
